_doc: Quest catalog. Two tracks. `daily` is a rotating pool: quest-engine.js picks a fixed number of them per day (seeded by the date, so everyone bot-wide sees the same set and it changes at midnight). `milestone` is a one-time ordered track: each entry is claimable once ever, gated on a lifetime counter, and they surface roughly in order. Every quest has a `metric` (what event advances it) and a `goal` (how many). Rewards: type is one of solars|xp|gems|stamina|seasonPoints (a plain amount paid straight into the wallet) or item|character (granted through addOwnedSeasonContent, itemId required). Copy is player-facing: no dashes, commas and colons only.
_scenarioNote: Season 2 scenario ladder, Phases A to C. The 28 s2_ milestone records are tiers 1 to 5 of docs/season-02-scenarios.md, static records on this existing engine. Stars are the Season 2 player facing name of the seasonPoints balance, earned only and never sold, so reward.type seasonPoints pays them. The season scoped emitters live in lib/scenario-metrics.js at the real event sites: tower_kill, tower_floor, boss_clear, party_floor, death_on_floor, consumable_used, season_open, season_shop_buy, and the floor clear condition counters no_item_clear, species_pair, regression_clear, plus Phase C's new_floor_clear and no_death_streak. Phase C adds the Personal Scenario generator (lib/scenario-personal.js) and the .scenario command (plugins/scenario.js), which reads the lifetime counters as a lens and pays a clear in Stars. The remaining metrics record harmlessly into lifetime until their own phase wires them: the combat condition hooks (ability_used, shield_break, no_hit_streak), the wing and weekly and contract conditions, gates and the broadcast and wager and token systems in their phases, see section 18. A record whose metric is not emitted yet simply stays at zero. scenario.bonusReward and scenario.title are paid by the scenario claim flow. scenario.failPenalty and scenario.reset are enforced in Phase D. scenario.no is the doc number, scenario.tier is the ladder tier.

metrics.kill: a monster killed in a dungeon (any dungeon, swarm or 1v1)
metrics.fish: a fish landed on a cast (plugins/fish.js, only a won cast)
metrics.mine: an ore vein mined (plugins/mine.js, only a completed swing)
metrics.season_open: the season window opened (plugins/season.js). Season 2, scenario 1
metrics.tower_kill: a monster killed in the Grand Tower of Gates. Season 2, scenario 2
metrics.consumable_used: a consumable used, food or healing item. Season 2, scenario 3
metrics.constellation_seen: a first constellation reaction seen (broadcast system). Season 2, scenario 4
metrics.tower_floor: a Grand Tower of Gates floor cleared. Season 2, climb scenarios
metrics.party_floor: a floor cleared with more than one player. Season 2, scenario 6
metrics.gate_seal: a seal contributed to a gate. Season 2, scenario 8
metrics.season_shop_buy: a purchase from the season shop. Season 2, scenario 9
metrics.boss_clear: a tower boss floor cleared. Season 2, scenario 10
metrics.no_item_clear: a boss floor cleared with no consumable used. Season 2, scenario 11
metrics.blind_floor: a floor cleared with the combat readout hidden. Season 2, scenario 12
metrics.regression_clear: a floor cleared after dying on it, without dying again. Season 2, scenario 13. death_on_floor is the enabling defeat event
metrics.species_pair: two different species killed on one floor. Season 2, scenario 14
metrics.ability_free_wing: a full wing cleared without using a character ability. Season 2, scenario 15. ability_used is the underlying per combat counter
metrics.shield_break: a fortify shield broken on an enemy. Season 2, scenario 16. Emitter lands with the Phase C combat condition hook
metrics.death_on_floor: a real death on a tower floor. Season 2, live. Feeds the Regression and One Who Came Back condition checks
metrics.ability_used: a character ability used in combat. Season 2. Emitter lands with the Phase C combat condition hook. Feeds The Quiet Carriage and No Anthem
metrics.no_hit_streak: best run of consecutive tower floors cleared without taking a hit. Season 2. Emitter lands with the Phase C damage hook. Feeds Immaculate and Untouched
metrics.equipment_count: equipment worn at the start of a floor. Season 2. Feeds Empty Handed
metrics.gate_prevented: a gate prevented at settlement. Season 2. Emitter lands with the gate system. Feeds The Long Watch and Nothing Gets Through
metrics.viewers_peak: peak Viewers reached. Season 2. Wired in Phase E by lib/scenario-viewers.js as the audience grows. Feeds Crowd Favourite
metrics.blessings_refused: constellation blessings refused. Season 2. Emitter lands with the Phase E constellation system. Feeds Without the System
metrics.revive_given: another player revived. Season 2. Emitter lands with the revive action. Feeds Demon King of Salvation
metrics.wager_staked: Stars staked on a wager accept. Season 2. Wired in Phase E by the .scenario accept wager flow. Feeds All In
metrics.regression_used: a Regression Token spent. Season 2. Wired in Phase E by the .scenario retry flow
metrics.tower_floor_week: tower floors cleared inside one week. Season 2, scenario 18. Weekly window evaluated by the Phase C scenario flow
metrics.contract_wing: a full wing cleared under an accepted contract rule. Season 2, scenario 19. Phase C contract flow
metrics.equipment_free_wing: a full wing cleared wearing no equipment. Season 2, scenario 20. Phase C condition flow
metrics.comeback_clear: a floor cleared within 3 attempts of dying on it. Season 2, scenario 22. Phase C condition flow
metrics.boss_clear_at_one: a boss floor cleared standing at 1 HP. Season 2, scenario 23. Phase C condition flow
metrics.passive_free_wing: a full wing cleared without the character passive. Season 2, scenario 24. Phase C condition flow
metrics.no_death_streak: best run of consecutive tower floors cleared without dying. Season 2, scenario 25. Wired in Phase C: the streak climbs per clear and resets on a tower death
metrics.solo_tower_floor: tower floors reached without ever joining a party. Season 2, scenario 26. Phase C condition flow
metrics.debuff_floor_clear: a floor cleared while under three debuffs at once. Season 2, scenario 27. Phase C condition flow
metrics.thrifty_tower_floor: tower floors reached using 50 consumables or fewer in total. Season 2, scenario 28. Phase C condition flow
metrics.new_floor_clear: a tower floor cleared that is higher than any cleared before. Season 2 Personal Scenario (Higher, Not Again). Wired in Phase C
metrics.clean_floor_streak: best run of consecutive tower floors cleared with no death and no consumable. Season 2, scenario 29. Emitter lands with the Phase F combat condition hook. Feeds Untouched
metrics.tower_floor_peak: the highest Grand Tower of Gates floor reached. Season 2, scenario 30. Emitter lands with the 500 floor tower. Feeds The Last Scenario
metrics.floor_500_boss_no_revive: the floor 500 boss cleared without a revive. Season 2, scenario 31. Emitter lands with the 500 floor tower. Feeds Only Once
metrics.floor_500_boss_solo_first: the floor 500 boss cleared solo on the first attempt with no death. Season 2, scenario 32. Emitter lands with the 500 floor tower. Feeds The Man Who Read the End
metrics.gate_week_clean: a full week with no gate breached. Season 2, scenario 33. Emitter lands with the gate system. Feeds Nothing Gets Through
metrics.peak_wing_wager: a Peak wing cleared with a maximum wager staked. Season 2, scenario 34. Emitter lands with the wing and wager settlement. Feeds All In
metrics.full_tower_run: the whole tower 1 to 500 cleared in one continuous run with no checkpoint. Season 2, scenario 35. Emitter lands with the 500 floor tower. Feeds The 1863rd
metrics.season_most_watched: finished the season as the single most watched player. Season 2, scenario 36. Awarded at season end from the viewers_peak ranking. Feeds Dokkaebi's Favourite
metrics.evelyn_true_name: Evelyn's true name found across the three hidden scenes. Season 2, scenario 37. Wired in Phase G by lib/hidden-scenarios.js when all three scenes are read, the third only at 3am WAT. Feeds The Name You Lost
metrics.party_wing_clean: a full wing cleared by a party of four with zero party deaths. Season 2, scenario 38. Emitter lands with the party wing settlement. Feeds Nobody Dies
metrics.scenario_completed: Season 2 scenarios claimed on the ladder. Season 2, scenario 41. Wired in Phase F by the milestone claim flow. Feeds The Complete Reader
